options.name: Animal Fury
options.benefit: Gain a bite attack while raging.

options.name: Clear Mind
options.benefit: Reroll one failed Will save while raging, once per rage.

options.name: Fearless Rage
options.benefit: Become immune to shaken and frightened conditions while raging.

options.name: Guarded Stance
options.benefit: Gain a scaling dodge bonus to Armor Class while raging.

options.name: Increased Damage Reduction
options.benefit: Increase your damage reduction by 1; this power can be selected up to three times.

options.name: Internal Fortitude
options.benefit: Become immune to sickened and nauseated conditions while raging.

options.name: Intimidating Glare
options.benefit: Make an adjacent foe shaken with an Intimidate check while raging.

options.name: Knockback
options.benefit: Attempt a bull rush in place of a melee attack while raging without provoking.

options.name: Low-Light Vision
options.benefit: Gain low-light vision while raging, or double its range if you already have it.

options.name: Mighty Swing
options.benefit: Automatically confirm one critical threat while raging, once per rage.

options.name: Moment of Clarity
options.benefit: Suspend rage benefits and penalties for one round, once per rage.

options.name: Night Vision
options.benefit: Gain darkvision 60 feet while raging.

options.name: No Escape
options.benefit: Use an immediate action to move up to double speed after a withdrawing foe, once per rage.

options.name: Powerful Blow
options.benefit: Add barbarian level to one damage roll while raging, once per rage.

options.name: Quick Reflexes
options.benefit: Make one additional attack of opportunity each round while raging.

options.name: Raging Climber
options.benefit: Add barbarian level as an enhancement bonus on Climb checks while raging.

options.name: Raging Leaper
options.benefit: Add barbarian level as an enhancement bonus on Acrobatics checks to jump while raging.

options.name: Raging Swimmer
options.benefit: Add barbarian level as an enhancement bonus on Swim checks while raging.

options.name: Renewed Vigor
options.benefit: Heal 1d8 plus Constitution modifier hit points once per day while raging, improving with level.

options.name: Rolling Dodge
options.benefit: Gain a scaling dodge bonus against ranged attacks while raging.

options.name: Roused Anger
options.benefit: Enter rage while fatigued, becoming exhausted afterward.

options.name: Scent
options.benefit: Gain the scent ability while raging.

options.name: Strength Surge
options.benefit: Add barbarian level to one Strength check or combat maneuver check while raging, once per rage.

options.name: Superstition
options.benefit: Gain a scaling morale bonus on saves against spells and supernatural or spell-like abilities while raging.

options.name: Surprise Accuracy
options.benefit: Gain a morale bonus on one attack roll while raging, once per rage.

options.name: Swift Foot
options.benefit: Increase your land speed by 5 feet while raging; this power can be selected up to three times.

options.name: Terrifying Howl
options.benefit: Panic nearby shaken enemies with a howl while raging.

options.name: Unexpected Strike
options.benefit: Make an attack of opportunity against a foe that moves into a threatened square, once per rage.
